none: PAS NLM-1520B3: Roman Coin: Nummus of Licinius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Tetrarchic nummus of Licinius I (308-324), issue of 308-313, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]IMP LICINIVS[---]. Reverse description: Genius standing left holding cornucopiae and patera. Reverse inscription: [GENIO POPVLI ] ROMANI. Diameter: 23.2mm, Weight: 3.36gms, die axis: 6
